properties.description: Window (14 ) and door ( 1) change-out (same size & type) for residential buildings.  Dual glazing, labeled and certified by National Fenestration Rating Council (NFRC), is required for doors and windows replaced in all residential buildings, three stories or less, per Section 150.2(b)1B of Title 24. Re-roof with Class A or B material weighing less than 6 pounds per sq. ft. over new solid sheathing 26 squares.  For residential roof replacement > 50% of the total roof area, apply Cool Roof Product labeled and certified by Cool Roofing Rating Council (CRRC). Cool Roof may be required for non-residential buildings per Title 24, Part 6, Section 141.0(b)2B.
